title: Student Transportation Services Rider Conduct and Afternoon Release Figures by Transportation Type
content:
The bus conduct ladder of Student Transportation Services counts offenses within the school year. The same ladder applies to every transportation type:

| Offense number in the school year | Riding suspension |
|---|---|
| 1 | 0 school days (a written warning) |
| 2 | 3 school days |
| 3 | 5 school days |
| 4 | 10 school days |
| 5 | the remainder of the semester |

## Figures by transportation type

| Transportation type | Offense number at which a courtesy permit is revoked without credit | District provides alternate transportation during a riding suspension | Grades released at the PM stop only to a parent or authorized adult |
|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) | 3 | no | PK3, PK4, KG, 01, 02 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | 3 | no | PK3, PK4, KG, 01, 02 |
| Regular Route Eligibility | 0 (not applicable) | no | PK3, PK4, KG, 01, 02 |
| Hazardous Route Eligibility | 0 (not applicable) | no | PK3, PK4, KG, 01, 02 |
| Choice Program Hub Shuttle | 0 (not applicable) | no | PK3, PK4, KG, 01, 02 |
| McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation | 0 (not applicable) | yes | PK3, PK4, KG, 01, 02 |
| Special Education Transportation | 0 (not applicable) | yes | PK3, PK4, KG, 01 through 12 |

## No-adult returns, every transportation type

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Returns to campus in one semester, because no authorized adult met the student, at which a riding suspension applies | 3 |
| School days of riding suspension applied when that limit is reached | 3 |

## Reading the ladder (hypothetical riders)

- A Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) rider's third referral of the school year is the offense number 3, at which the permit is revoked without credit.
- A Regular Route Eligibility rider's third referral carries a suspension of 5 school days; there is no revocation number for that type.
